title: fix(objectql): the unserved single knowledge_source warning says the item is not loaded
body:
Fixes #38063

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:只有一个知识源条目、又没挂知识服务的部署,启动警告原先说"它已加载、已索引、可搜索",现在如实说"未加载"。
- 为什么做:该句与事实相反,会让人误以为知识源在工作。
- 出错会怎样:只是一行日志文字,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`describeUnservedKnowledgeSources` rendered `it is loaded, indexed or searched` for exactly one item; it now renders `it is not loaded, indexed or searched`. The plural `none is` arm is unchanged. A patch changeset for `@objectstack/objectql` is included.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/knowledge-source-unserved.test.ts`: the singular pin is the negated text, plus `not.toContain('it is loaded')`.
- Red on the old source: 1 failed | 6 passed (expected the line to contain 'it is not loaded, indexed or searched').
- Green on the fix: 7 passed (7); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0, both under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0).

## Acceptance notes

No other test, doc or fixture quotes the old singular sentence (`git grep "it is loaded, indexed"` hit only the test pin).

## Verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/knowledge-source-unserved.test.ts` expects 7 passed.
